evidence.origin: Illustrative campus circulation revision authored 29 October 2026 from the retained R6 manifold installation. The common inter-unit road uses orthogonal service approaches and joined tangent pavement; the shared unit 3 approach bypasses the first Tegneby support on its north side. Complete road surfaces are checked against actual canonical east/north/up building and represented unit/campus equipment envelopes. Related unit geometry, graph bindings and coverage are retained. Vehicle swept-path and electrical-clearance qualification is not established. This is an architectural study, not OEM, as-built or safety qualification.
